fullDescription: A destructive-confirm modal in a clean white + ink + signal-red system: a centered white dialog lifted by one soft shadow, a pulsing red warning icon, an 'Irreversible' chip, a specific named title, a quantified 'this can’t be undone' consequence line, and a paired quiet Cancel / red Delete action, on a full pattern-library page (anatomy, good-vs-bad, principles).
prompt:
## Resumo
A full destructive-confirm modal landing page in a clean white + ink + signal-red system: a sticky frosted nav, an editorial hero that pairs a heavy Inter headline with the real centered confirm dialog (animated warning icon, an 'Irreversible' chip, a named title 'Delete Q3 Launch canvas?', a quantified consequence note, and a paired Cancel / red Delete action), a four-card 'Anatomy' breakdown of the dialog, a side-by-side good-vs-bad ('Are you sure?' anti-pattern vs a specific 'Delete 18 records?' dialog), a six-card prompt-library strip, a dark principles band, a dark rounded CTA, and a hairline footer. Built on Inter (weights 400-900) with a single signal-red accent family and a cool ink neutral ramp; depth comes from one large soft 'dialog' shadow, hairline borders, blur-glow blobs, and a faint dotted paper grain rather than heavy chrome.

## Estilo Visual
Use a white + cool-ink + signal-red design system. Page background is white (#ffffff); section bands alternate white with a pale cool ink-50 (#f7f8fa) tint, and one dark band uses ink-900 (#141820). Neutral ramp is a cool ink scale: 50 #f7f8fa, 100 #eef1f5, 200 #dde2ea, 300 #c2cad6, 400 #8c97a8, 500 #5d6779, 600 #444d5e, 700 #323a48, 800 #21262f, 900 #141820 — text uses ink-800/900 for headings, ink-500 for body, ink-600 for secondary. The single accent is a 'signal' red family used ONLY for the destructive action and warning state: 50 #fef3f1, 100 #fde3de, 200 #fbc7bd, 400 #ff6a52, 500 #e5341f, 600 #cf2a17, 700 #ac2213; primary danger button is signal-600 hover signal-700, the warning icon and 'irreversible' chip are signal-500 on signal-50 ringed signal-100/200. One typeface, Inter (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800/900); headings are font-extrabold (800) with tight tracking (-0.03em on the hero) and text-wrap:balance, body is normal-weight ink-500, eyebrows are 13px font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] in signal-600. Radii are generous and consistent: cards rounded-2xl, the dialog rounded-[22px], buttons rounded-xl, the CTA panel rounded-[28px]. Shadows are sparing: one large soft 'dialog' shadow (0 40px 80px -20px rgba(20,24,32,0.35), 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(20,24,32,0.25)) on the confirm dialog, and a lighter 'card' shadow (0 1px 2px rgba(20,24,32,0.04), 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(20,24,32,0.18)) on hover; otherwise hierarchy comes from hairline ink-100 borders and ring-1 ink-100. Add atmosphere with two large blurred radial glow blobs (signal-100/40 and ink-200/40, blur-3xl) behind the hero and red glow blobs behind the dark CTA, plus a faint dotted 'grain' (radial-gradient circle 1px rgba(20,24,32,0.04) on a 22px tile) on the ink-50 bands. The warning icon has a gentle pulsing halo ring (a scale 1->1.06 opacity 1->0.85 keyframe over 2.6s).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky translucent header
A `<header class="sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-ink-100 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md">` holding a `mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-7xl items-center justify-between px-6 lg:px-8` row. Left: a brand lockup = a 32px ink-900 rounded-lg square with a white Phosphor warning-octagon icon (ph:warning-octagon-fill), the extrabold wordmark 'Modal', and a small signal 'DESIGN' chip (rounded-full, border-signal-200, bg-signal-50, text-signal-600, uppercase tracking-wider, hidden below sm). Center (hidden below md): four 14px font-medium ink-500 links (Patterns, Anatomy, Library, Principles) that hover to ink-900. Right: a ghost 'Sign in' link (hidden below sm) and a filled ink-900 'Start designing' button (rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-white hover:bg-ink-800).

### Hero: copy + the real confirm dialog
A `relative overflow-hidden border-b border-ink-100 bg-ink-50 grain` section with two blurred glow blobs (a -left signal-100/40 and a -right ink-200/40, both blur-3xl, pointer-events-none). Inside, a `grid max-w-7xl grid-cols-1 items-center gap-16 lg:grid-cols-12` with py-20 lg:py-28. LEFT (lg:col-span-6): a pill eyebrow (white, border-ink-200, a tiny signal-500 dot, 'Destructive-action pattern, perfected'), a balance-wrapped extrabold H1 up to 60px with tracking-[-0.03em] ('The confirm dialog people actually read.'), an 18px ink-500 lead paragraph, two CTAs (a signal-600 'See the anatomy' with a ph:arrow-down-right-bold icon + a white/border-ink-200 'Browse patterns'), and a trust row of two items with signal-600 ph:check-circle-fill / ph:keyboard-fill icons ('WCAG-checked contrast', 'Focus-trapped & keyboard-safe'). RIGHT (lg:col-span-6): the dialog (next part).

### The confirm dialog (the centerpiece)
Centered in the hero's right column, a `relative mx-auto max-w-md`: a soft scrim plate behind it (`absolute inset-0 -m-6 rounded-[28px] bg-ink-900/[0.04]`), then the card `relative overflow-hidden rounded-[22px] bg-white p-8 sm:p-10 shadow-dialog ring-1 ring-ink-100`. Top-right: an 'IRREVERSIBLE' chip (rounded-full bg-signal-50 text-signal-600 ring-1 ring-signal-100, uppercase tracking-wider, a ph:prohibit-bold glyph). Centered warning icon: a 64px wrapper with an absolute pulsing signal-100 halo ring (pulse-ring keyframe) and a 56px signal-50 disc ringed signal-200 holding a 30px signal-500 ph:warning-fill. A 24px font-bold ink-900 title naming the object ('Delete “Q3 Launch” canvas?'), a centered 15px ink-500 consequence line with the count bolded ('permanently removes the canvas and its 42 components. This can’t be undone.'), then a `flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:justify-center` action row: a quiet bordered 'Cancel' (border-ink-200 bg-white text-ink-700) and the destructive 'Delete canvas' (bg-signal-600 hover:signal-700 text-white, a ph:trash-simple-bold icon). Cancel sits first on mobile (flex-col-reverse) so the safe choice is closest to the thumb.

### Anatomy four-card grid
A white section (id=anatomy) with a max-w-2xl intro (a signal-600 'Anatomy' eyebrow, a 42px extrabold H2 'Four parts. Each one earns its place.', a 17px ink-500 paragraph), then a `grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4` of four cards. Each card: `rounded-2xl border border-ink-100 bg-ink-50/60 p-7` that on hover gets border-signal-200 + bg-white + shadow-card; an 11px square icon tile (signal-50/signal-100 ring for the red ones #01 warning & #04 cursor-click, ink-100/ink-200 ring for the neutral ones #02 text-aa & #03 info), a 12px tracked number ('01'-'04'), an 18px bold ink-900 title (Warning icon / Specific title / Consequence note / Paired actions) and a 14px ink-500 description.

### Good-vs-bad patterns pair
An ink-50 grain section (id=patterns) with a centered max-w-2xl heading (signal-600 'The difference' eyebrow, 42px extrabold 'Same red button. Worlds apart.'), then a `mx-auto max-w-4xl grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2`. BAD card: `rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white p-2 shadow-card` with a header row (ink-600 ph:x-circle-fill 'Vague & risky' + an ink-800 'DON'T' pill with ph:prohibit-bold) over a specimen on bg-ink-50 — a grey ph:question disc, a low-contrast 'Are you sure?' title, vague body, and a flat grey Cancel + signal-500 Delete (intentional anti-pattern, with an 'Anti-pattern' caption). GOOD card: `rounded-2xl border-2 border-signal-200 bg-white p-2 shadow-dialog` with a header row (signal-600 ph:check-circle-fill 'Clear & honest' + a signal-600 'DO' pill with ph:check-bold) over a specimen — a signal-50 ph:warning-fill disc, a solid ink-900 'Delete 18 records?' title, a concrete consequence, and a bordered Cancel + signal-600 'Delete 18' button.

### Prompt-library strip
A white section (id=library) with a `flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-end justify-between` header (left: signal-600 'Prompt library' eyebrow + 42px extrabold 'Start from a prompt, ship a pattern.'; right: a signal-600 'Open the full library' link with ph:arrow-right-bold), then a `grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3` of six `flex items-start gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-ink-100 p-6 hover:border-signal-200 hover:shadow-card` cards. Each: a 40px square icon tile (signal-50/signal-100 ring for destructive items, ink-100/ink-200 ring for neutral) + a 16px bold title and 14px ink-500 line — Delete confirmation (ph:trash-bold, red), Type-to-confirm (ph:keyboard-bold), Undo snackbar (ph:arrow-counter-clockwise-bold), Discard changes (ph:sign-out-bold), Remove access (ph:user-minus-bold, red), Cancel subscription (ph:credit-card-bold).

### Dark principles band
A `bg-ink-900 text-white` section (id=principles) as a `grid grid-cols-1 gap-12 lg:grid-cols-12 lg:gap-16`. LEFT (col-span-5): a signal-400 'Principles' eyebrow, a 42px extrabold white H2 ('Friction is a feature. Spend it on the dangerous click.'), and a 17px ink-300 paragraph. RIGHT (col-span-7): a `divide-y divide-ink-700/70 border-y border-ink-700/70` list of three rows, each a `flex gap-5 py-6` with a signal-500 Phosphor icon (ph:eye-bold / ph:hand-bold / ph:chat-text-bold), an 18px bold white title and a 15px ink-400 line (Match weight to stakes / Never pre-select danger / Say what is lost).

### Dark CTA panel + footer
A white section holding a `relative overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] bg-ink-900 px-8 py-16 sm:px-16 sm:py-20 text-center` panel with two blurred signal-500/20 and signal-500/10 glow blobs; inside, a balance-wrapped up-to-44px extrabold white H2 ('Design the dialog before the data is gone.'), a max-w-xl ink-300 paragraph, and two CTAs (a signal-500 'Start designing free' with ph:arrow-right-bold + a border-ink-700 ghost 'Browse the library'). Below, a `border-t border-ink-100 bg-white` footer that is a `flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-6 px-6 py-10` row: the Modal mark + tagline 'destructive patterns, designed right', four ink-500 nav links, and a '© 2026 Modal Design' line.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Build the canonical destructive confirm as a centered white card (rounded-[22px], p-8/10, one large soft 'dialog' shadow, ring-1 ink-100) sitting on a faint -m-6 ink-900/4 scrim plate so it reads as lifted off the page. It carries, top to bottom: an 'IRREVERSIBLE' status chip pinned top-right, a centered signal-red warning icon with a pulsing halo, a SPECIFIC title that names the exact object ('Delete “Q3 Launch” canvas?', not 'Are you sure?'), a quantified consequence line with the count bolded and 'This can’t be undone.', and a paired Cancel / red Delete action row. Cancel renders first in DOM (flex-col-reverse on mobile) so on small screens the SAFE button is nearest the thumb and the danger button is reached deliberately.

### Componente
A 64px icon stack: an absolute signal-100 disc behind a 56px signal-50 disc ringed signal-200 holding a 30px signal-500 ph:warning-fill. Animate only the back disc with a 'pulse-ring' keyframe (transform scale 1->1.06 and opacity 1->0.85 at the 50% mark, 2.6s ease-in-out infinite) so the warning gently breathes without distracting from the copy.

### Componente
Teach the pattern with two side-by-side mini-dialogs in tray cards: a BAD one (single ink-200 border, ph:question disc, low-contrast 'Are you sure?' + vague body, flat grey Cancel and a lone red Delete, tagged 'DON'T' / 'Anti-pattern') and a GOOD one (double signal-200 border + the heavier 'dialog' shadow, signal warning disc, a specific 'Delete 18 records?' with a concrete consequence, a bordered Cancel + a 'Delete 18' button, tagged 'DO'). The contrast itself is the lesson — same red button, opposite outcomes.

### Componente
Small rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider chips with a leading Phosphor glyph: an 'IRREVERSIBLE' chip (signal-50 fill, signal-600 text, ring-1 signal-100, ph:prohibit) on the live dialog; a 'DON'T' chip (solid ink-800, white text, ph:prohibit) and a 'DO' chip (solid signal-600, white text, ph:check) on the specimen headers. They label state and intent at a glance.

### Componente
Reusable card primitive: a rounded-2xl hairline-bordered card on bg-ink-50/60 that lifts on hover (border-signal-200 + bg-white + soft 'card' shadow), led by a square icon tile whose color encodes meaning — signal-50 fill + signal-100 ring + signal-500 icon for DESTRUCTIVE items, ink-100 fill + ink-200 ring + ink-700 icon for NEUTRAL/informational items — followed by an optional step number, a bold ink-900 title, and an ink-500 description line.

## Notas Especiais
Single typeface: Inter (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800/900); headings font-extrabold (800), eyebrows 13px bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em]. Icons are Phosphor via Iconify (ph:warning-octagon-fill, ph:warning-fill, ph:prohibit-bold, ph:trash-simple-bold, ph:trash-bold, ph:question-bold, ph:check-circle-fill, ph:x-circle-fill, ph:check-bold, ph:keyboard-fill/bold, ph:arrow-down-right-bold, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:cursor-click-fill, ph:text-aa-bold, ph:info-bold, ph:arrow-counter-clockwise-bold, ph:sign-out-bold, ph:user-minus-bold, ph:credit-card-bold, ph:eye-bold, ph:hand-bold, ph:chat-text-bold). Exact tokens — neutrals 'ink': 50 #f7f8fa, 100 #eef1f5, 200 #dde2ea, 300 #c2cad6, 400 #8c97a8, 500 #5d6779, 600 #444d5e, 700 #323a48, 800 #21262f, 900 #141820; accent 'signal' (red, danger only): 50 #fef3f1, 100 #fde3de, 200 #fbc7bd, 400 #ff6a52, 500 #e5341f, 600 #cf2a17, 700 #ac2213. Shadows: 'dialog' = 0 40px 80px -20px rgba(20,24,32,0.35), 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(20,24,32,0.25); 'card' = 0 1px 2px rgba(20,24,32,0.04), 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(20,24,32,0.18). Effects: a dotted 'grain' radial-gradient (circle 1px rgba(20,24,32,0.04) on 22px tile) on ink-50 bands, large blur-3xl glow blobs behind the hero and dark CTA, and the warning-icon 'pulse-ring' keyframe. The whole page is a `sticky top-0` nav over six max-w-7xl sections and reflows to a single column at 390px (hero stacks copy over dialog, all grids collapse, nav links hide, the buttons persist). Accessibility intent: red is reserved strictly for the destructive action + warning state, the safe Cancel button gets visual default weight, and the dialog states a specific object + a quantified, recoverability-explicit consequence.

It carries, top to bottom: an 'IRREVERSIBLE' status chip pinned top-right, a centered signal-red warning icon with a pulsing halo, a SPECIFIC title that names the exact object ('Delete “Q3 Launch” canvas?', not 'Are you sure?'), a quantified consequence line with the count bolded and 'This can’t be undone.', and a paired Cancel / red Delete action row. Cancel renders first in DOM (flex-col-reverse on mobile) so on small screens the SAFE button is nearest the thumb and the danger button is reached deliberately.

A 64px icon stack: an absolute signal-100 disc behind a 56px signal-50 disc ringed signal-200 holding a 30px signal-500 ph:warning-fill. Animate only the back disc with a 'pulse-ring' keyframe (transform scale 1->1.06 and opacity 1->0.85 at the 50% mark, 2.6s ease-in-out infinite) so the warning gently breathes without distracting from the copy.

Teach the pattern with two side-by-side mini-dialogs in tray cards: a BAD one (single ink-200 border, ph:question disc, low-contrast 'Are you sure?' + vague body, flat grey Cancel and a lone red Delete, tagged 'DON'T' / 'Anti-pattern') and a GOOD one (double signal-200 border + the heavier 'dialog' shadow, signal warning disc, a specific 'Delete 18 records?' with a concrete consequence, a bordered Cancel + a 'Delete 18' button, tagged 'DO'). The contrast itself is the lesson — same red button, opposite outcomes.

Small rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider chips with a leading Phosphor glyph: an 'IRREVERSIBLE' chip (signal-50 fill, signal-600 text, ring-1 signal-100, ph:prohibit) on the live dialog; a 'DON'T' chip (solid ink-800, white text, ph:prohibit) and a 'DO' chip (solid signal-600, white text, ph:check) on the specimen headers. They label state and intent at a glance.

Reusable card primitive: a rounded-2xl hairline-bordered card on bg-ink-50/60 that lifts on hover (border-signal-200 + bg-white + soft 'card' shadow), led by a square icon tile whose color encodes meaning — signal-50 fill + signal-100 ring + signal-500 icon for DESTRUCTIVE items, ink-100 fill + ink-200 ring + ink-700 icon for NEUTRAL/informational items — followed by an optional step number, a bold ink-900 title, and an ink-500 description line.

structured.special_notes: Single typeface: Inter (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800/900); headings font-extrabold (800), eyebrows 13px bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em]. Icons are Phosphor via Iconify (ph:warning-octagon-fill, ph:warning-fill, ph:prohibit-bold, ph:trash-simple-bold, ph:trash-bold, ph:question-bold, ph:check-circle-fill, ph:x-circle-fill, ph:check-bold, ph:keyboard-fill/bold, ph:arrow-down-right-bold, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:cursor-click-fill, ph:text-aa-bold, ph:info-bold, ph:arrow-counter-clockwise-bold, ph:sign-out-bold, ph:user-minus-bold, ph:credit-card-bold, ph:eye-bold, ph:hand-bold, ph:chat-text-bold). Exact tokens — neutrals 'ink': 50 #f7f8fa, 100 #eef1f5, 200 #dde2ea, 300 #c2cad6, 400 #8c97a8, 500 #5d6779, 600 #444d5e, 700 #323a48, 800 #21262f, 900 #141820; accent 'signal' (red, danger only): 50 #fef3f1, 100 #fde3de, 200 #fbc7bd, 400 #ff6a52, 500 #e5341f, 600 #cf2a17, 700 #ac2213. Shadows: 'dialog' = 0 40px 80px -20px rgba(20,24,32,0.35), 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(20,24,32,0.25); 'card' = 0 1px 2px rgba(20,24,32,0.04), 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(20,24,32,0.18). Effects: a dotted 'grain' radial-gradient (circle 1px rgba(20,24,32,0.04) on 22px tile) on ink-50 bands, large blur-3xl glow blobs behind the hero and dark CTA, and the warning-icon 'pulse-ring' keyframe. The whole page is a `sticky top-0` nav over six max-w-7xl sections and reflows to a single column at 390px (hero stacks copy over dialog, all grids collapse, nav links hide, the buttons persist). Accessibility intent: red is reserved strictly for the destructive action + warning state, the safe Cancel button gets visual default weight, and the dialog states a specific object + a quantified, recoverability-explicit consequence.
